initiative: I6N DOIN local-island sequence: H4 then H72
problem: The retained I6N adapter implements a centralized shared-population path with an 8 by 3 pilot budget. It does not implement the required historical DOIN topology in which every node evolves a local population and exchanges champions over one blockchain.
constraints: The old shared-population behavior and its retained evidence remain unchanged.
Island mode requires an explicit i6n_island_mode=true configuration flag.
Each node has a local population of at least 20.
Each optimization allows at least 100 generations and uses patience of at least 10 generations.
min_relative_improvement is exactly 1e-8 and improvement is strict.
Only horizons 4 and 72 are eligible, in that order.
Every candidate is evaluated on all four quarterly folds; TEST is never read.
All four nodes use the same declared seed, blockchain identity, and exact repository commits.

data_scope.training: Four years ending before each quarterly inner fold
data_scope.inner_validation: Four distinct 2023 quarterly folds under the frozen business eligibility contract
data_scope.test: Excluded from search, ranking, early stopping, and transition gates
data_scope.features: Frozen selected RAW feature manifest and its governed digests

objective: Minimize mean four-fold relative error, reported as error_ratio_minus_one; negative values beat the paired naive for the same horizon and support.

test_status.expected: GREEN for the implemented local-island and external-archive component contracts
test_status.observed: GREEN: predictor integration 108 passed; doin-node integration 27 passed; doin-plugins 13 passed; doin-core archive 16 passed on 2026-10-12

archive_integration.external_content: effective config, canonical genotype identity, candidate metrics, four fold ratios and provenance identities
archive_integration.olap_projection: four fold reports plus one candidate report with exact readback
archive_integration.remaining_gate: fleet deployment and first finalized production candidate readback; the closure producer is autonomous and fail-closed

next_allowed_actions: Deploy the exact committed artifacts and sealed H4 configuration to all four local islands.
Verify exact seed, network, genesis, chain checkpoint and component commits across all four node APIs.
Verify a finalized production candidate reference through CAS and OLAP readback before declaring alpha acceptance.
blocked_actions: Do not launch an H4 or H72 campaign before unit, integration, and system gates pass.
Do not use the shared-population 8 by 3 pilot as scientific evidence.
Do not start H72 before H4 has a fleet terminal, common finalized chain checkpoint, and verified OLAP readback.
open_decisions: Whether group-safe crossover is admitted in addition to mutation and immigration.
Exact generation openings for S2 and S3 after cost admission.
Whether simultaneous use of both Gamma GPUs passes fresh host-memory admission.
